The <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a grave decoration which provides +2 {{Grave Decor}} when placed on a [[gravesite]], after a [[corpse]] has been buried there. Installing or uninstalling any grave decoration costs {{Energy|5}}. Excess wooden decor may be recycled at the [[chopping spot]], generating [[firewood]]. For more information, see [[graveyard]].
